response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS a FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), o AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS m FROM sentimentandfundamentals) SELECT AVG(g.a) AS mean_of_timing_avg_ownership, AVG(g.a - o.m) AS mean_excess_over_overall_avg FROM g, o WHERE g.a > o.m

assumptions.assumption: 'Average' for the threshold means the overall mean institutional ownership across all snapshot rows with non-null instownpct, not the mean of the per-timing averages.
Rows with a NULL eventannotm form their own group, and NULL instownpct values are ignored in every average. A timing whose ownership values are all NULL has no average and is excluded.
'How far above average' is the simple (unweighted) mean of each qualifying timing's average minus the overall average, so each timing counts equally regardless of row count.

alternatives.interpretation: The baseline is the unweighted mean of the per-timing average ownerships, instead of the row-level overall mean.
alternatives.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS a FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm HAVING AVG(instownpct) IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.a) AS mean_of_timing_avg_ownership, AVG(g.a - o.m) AS mean_excess_over_overall_avg FROM g, o WHERE g.a > o.m
